text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Menteri-Menteri Kerajaan

Persekutuan (Pindaan)(No. 2) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 19 April 2011.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Jadual kepada Perintah Menteri-Menteri Kerajaan Persekutuan 2009

[P.U. (A) 222/2009] dipinda berkenaan dengan Jabatan Perdana Menteri dengan

memotong perkataan "Dato' Murugiah a/l Thopasamy" dalam ruang "Nama" dan

perkataan "Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri" yang terdapat

bersetentangan dengannya dalam ruang "Gelaran dan Nama Jawatan".

Dibuat 1 Jun 2011

[PM(BK)S.11456/13 Jld. 50; PN(PU2)18/XXIV]

Dengan Titah Perintah

TAN SRI MOHD SIDEK BIN HJ. HASSAN

Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

MINISTERIAL FUNCTIONS ACT 1969

MINISTERS OF THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT)(NO. 2) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Ministerial Functions Act 1969

[Act 2], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Schedule to the Ministers of the Federal Government Order 2009

[P.U. (A) 222/2009] is amended in respect of the Prime Minister's Department by

deleting the words "Dato' Murugiah a/l Thopasamy" in the "Persons" column and the

words "Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister's Department" appearing against them in

the "Styles and Titles" column.

Made 1 June 2011

[PM(BK)S.11456/13 Jld. 50; PN(PU2)18/XXIV]

By Command

TAN SRI MOHD SIDEK BIN HJ. HASSAN

Secretary to the Cabinet

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Ministers of the Federal Government

(Amendment)(No. 2) Order 2011.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 19 April 2011.
